name: Carbon Black Cloud - Overview
description: The Carbon Black Cloud - Overview dashboard provides a high-level view of the state of your network infrastructure and systems. The panels highlight detected threats, hosts, top feeds and IOC’s, top processes, top watchlists, and alert trends.
title: Carbon Black Cloud - Overview

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/CarbonBlackCloudAlerts
| json field=_raw "category","device_name","device_username", "target_value", "device_group", "threat_id", "device_os", "type" as severity, device, user,target_priority, device_group, incident_id, device_os, type nodrop //s3
| timeslice 1h
| count_distinct (incident_id) as alerts by _timeslice, type
| fillmissing timeslice, values all in type
| transpose row _timeslice column type

_sourceCategory=Labs/CarbonBlackCloudAlerts 
| json field=_raw "category","device_name","device_username", "target_value", "device_group", "threat_id", "device_os", "type" as severity, device, user,target_priority, device_group, incident_id, device_os, type nodrop //s3
| where type="WATCHLIST"
| count_distinct (incident_id)

_sourceCategory=Labs/CarbonBlackCloudAlerts 
| json field=_raw "category","device_name","device_username", "target_value", "device_group", "threat_id", "device_os", "type" as severity, device, user,target_priority, device_group, incident_id, device_os, type nodrop //s3
| where type="CB_ANALYTICS"
| count_distinct (incident_id)

_sourceCategory=Labs/CarbonBlackCloudAlerts 
| json field=_raw "severity","device_name","device_username", "target_value", "device_group", "threat_id", "device_os", "type", "status" as severity, device, user,target_priority, device_group, incident_id, device_os, type, status nodrop //s3
| count_distinct(incident_id) by severity

_sourceCategory=Labs/CarbonBlackCloudAlerts 
| json field=_raw "severity","device_name","device_username", "target_value", "device_group", "threat_id", "device_os", "type", "status", "sensor_action" as severity, device, user,target_priority, device_group, incident_id, device_os, type, status, sensor_action nodrop //s3
| where !isNull(sensor_action)
| count_distinct(incident_id) by sensor_action

_sourceCategory=Labs/CarbonBlackCloudAlerts 
| json field=_raw "severity","device_name","device_username", "target_value", "device_group", "threat_id", "device_os", "type", "status", "sensor_action" as severity, device_name, user,target_priority, device_group, incident_id, device_os, type, status, sensor_action nodrop //s3
| where !isNull(sensor_action)
| count_distinct(incident_id) as count by device_name
| sort by count
| limit 10

_sourceCategory=Labs/CarbonBlackCloudAlerts 
| json field=_raw "severity","device_name","device_username", "target_value", "device_group", "threat_id", "device_os", "type", "status", "sensor_action", "process_name" as severity, device_name, user,target_priority, device_group, incident_id, device_os, type, status, sensor_action, process_name nodrop //s3
| where !isNull(process_name)
| count_distinct(incident_id) as count by process_name
| sort by count
| limit 10

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/CarbonBlackCloudAlerts 
| json field=_raw "severity","device_name","device_username", "target_value", "device_group", "threat_id", "device_os", "type", "status", "sensor_action", "process_name", "reason" as severity, device_name, user,target_priority, device_group, incident_id, device_os, type, status, sensor_action, process_name, reason nodrop //s3

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory=Labs/CarbonBlackCloudAlerts 
| json field=_raw "id", "alert_url" , "severity","category", "device_name","device_username", "target_value", "threat_id", "device_os", "type", "status", "process_name", "reason", "create_time" as alert_id, alert_url ,severity, category ,device_name, user,target_priority, incident_id, device_os, type, status, process_name, reason, create_time nodrop //s3
| json "threat_indicators[*].ttps" as threatInfo_indicators nodrop
| extract field=threatInfo_indicators "\"(?<indicators>.*?)\"(,|\])" multi nodrop
| json field=_raw "threat_cause_actor_name", "threat_cause_threat_category", "threat_cause_reputation" as threat_actor, threat_category, threat_reputation nodrop
| count_distinct (alert_id) as count by threat_actor
| sort by count
